sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 10118 of 2023

Applicant :- Wajid Hussain
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Akhilesh Kumar Shukla,Ashutosh Mishra,Atul Kumar Shahi,Ravi Sha
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as the learned AGA and perused the material available on record.
2.

Present application has been moved on behalf of the applicant - Wajid Hussain seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.133 of 2017, under Sections 406, 420, 465 IPC, P.S. Nakhasa,
District Sambhal.

3. This is second anticipatory bail application on behalf of the applicant with the sole ground that co-accused Mohd. Nasir has been granted anticipatory bail by the coordinate Bench of this Court on 22.5.2023 vide Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No. 5401 of 2023.

sentences.text: The first anticipatory bail application moved by the present applicant as Criminal Misc.
Anticipatory Bail Application No. 7907 of 2022 was dismissed on merits vide order dated 5.1.2023.

So far as the aforesaid anticipatory bail application moved by the co-accused Mohd. Nasir is concerned, the coordinate Bench of this Court with a view that the offences alleged against the applicant are punishable with the imprisonment for a maximum period of seven years disposed of the same vide order dated 22.5.2023.

It has also been observed in the said order that the applicant is already protected from arrest by virtue of provisions of Sections 41, 41-A, 60-A Cr.P.C. and also in view of the judgement of the Apex Court passed in Arnesh Kumar vs. State of Bihar and another,
(2014) 8 SCC 273 and also in Satender Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another LL 2022 SC 577.
6.

entities.text:
Arnesh Kumar vs. State of Bihar and another,
(2014) 8 SCC 273
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Satender Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another LL 2022 SC 577
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view of the above, since the first anticipatory bail application of the applicant has been dismissed on merits and also taking into account the view expressed by the coordinate Bench of this Court while disposing of the anticipatory bail application of the co-accused Mohd. Nasir, I do not find it fit to allow this application.
7.

It is clarified that since the alleged offences against the applicant are punishable with the imprisonment for a maximum period of seven years, statutory protection, as mentioned in the aforesaid order dated 22.5.2023 passed by the coordinate Bench of this Court in the aforesaid anticipatory bail application moved by the co-accused Mohd. Nasir, is already available to the present applicant.
8.
The application is disposed of accordingly.
